skills.name: Iron Body
skills.description: Per rank: +2% damage reduction, +2% Strength-weapon damage and −2% stamina usage. No rank cap.

skills.name: Stonewall
skills.description: Per rank: 10% less incoming damage. Maximum five ranks.

skills.name: Honed Arms
skills.description: Per rank: −15% stamina usage per weapon attack. Maximum four ranks.

skills.name: Swiftfoot
skills.description: Per rank: +2% base movement speed and −5% sprint stamina usage. No rank cap.

skills.name: Dash
skills.description: Hold T to charge distance and release to dash. Queue an uppercut with left click while holding T.

skills.name: Streaming Dash
skills.description: Dash distance bonus by rank: +100% / +200% / +500%. Applies to quick and charged dashes.

skills.name: Dodge
skills.description: Ctrl or tap Shift to roll. Hold Shift to sprint. You remain vulnerable during the roll.

skills.name: Roly-Poly
skills.description: Roll speed bonus: +25% / +40% / +75%. Roll distance bonus: +25% / +50% / +80%.

skills.name: Speed-Freak
skills.description: Per rank: +25% of Swiftfoot-adjusted base speed for drawn and sheathed walking and sprinting. No rank cap.

skills.name: Great Greatsword
skills.description: Per rank: +5% base greatsword damage and −7% stamina per weapon swing. No rank cap.

skills.name: Charged Thrust
skills.description: Hold a thrust for up to five seconds. Each charged second adds 15% base attack damage; full charge deals 175%. Equip as your heavy attack.

skills.name: Fast Thrust
skills.description: Charge Charged Thrust twice as fast: reach its full five-second power in 2.5 real seconds.

skills.name: Breaker
skills.description: Accepted sword hits build stagger: +25% / +31.25% / +37.5% buildup by rank. Breaking interrupts the enemy and exposes it to +20% sword damage for 1.8 seconds.

skills.name: Basher
skills.description: Per rank: +15% base greatsword damage. Requires 15 additional greatsword kills for every rank. No rank cap.

skills.name: Devastating Blade
skills.description: Double the equipped greatsword's base damage. Requires Basher rank 3 and 400 total greatsword kills.
